shorts.title: What you will learn: Classes and objects
shorts.hook: Hide the data. Show only the buttons.
shorts.script: Hide the data. Show only the buttons. Today we meet classes. A class bundles data and the functions that work on it, and it hides the data from the outside. A class is a blueprint. An object is one thing built from the blueprint. A class has data and member functions. Data is private by default. Only the class itself can touch it. Keep coding, says Xecxec!
shorts.caption: What you will learn: Classes and objects.

shorts.title: Classes and objects in one minute
shorts.script: A class is a blueprint. An object is one thing built from the blueprint. A class has data and member functions. Data is private by default. Only the class itself can touch it. The public functions are the buttons that everyone may press. Think of a lift. You press a button, but you never touch the motor. This is the class. Keep coding, says Xecxec!
shorts.caption: Classes and objects in one minute.

shorts.title: Inside the second program
shorts.hook: We make two objects from one class.
shorts.script: We make two objects from one class. Each object has its own count. We add one twice to a. We add one to b once. A has two, and b has one. The objects do not affect each other. The program prints two and one. A class is a blueprint, and an object is one thing built from it. Keep coding, says Xecxec!
shorts.caption: Inside the second program.

shorts.title: Bug of the Day: Touching private data
shorts.hook: Can you spot the bug in classes and objects?
shorts.script: Can you spot the bug in classes and objects? Bug of the Day. Main tries to set the private count. The compiler says count is private within this context. That is the whole point of private. Use a public function, such as increment, instead. Private data is only for the class. Outside code must use the public functions. Keep coding, says Xecxec!
shorts.caption: Bug of the Day: Touching private data.

shorts.title: Pun and challenge
shorts.hook: Can you build a Light class in classes and objects?
shorts.script: Can you build a Light class in classes and objects? I tried to read my class private data. It said, mind your own members. Write a class called Light with a private bool on. Add public functions turn on, turn off, and is on. Write your answer in the comments. A class is a blueprint, and an object is one thing built from it. Keep coding, says Xecxec!
shorts.caption: Pun and challenge.
